correctness.rationale: The inclusive distance-two clique definition is correctly used. Every pure Johnson-layer clique of three or more vertices belongs to a star or top; the mixed simplex has a unique vertex on one of the two ranks, and mixed edges alone are double counted. The oriented Euler identity thereby yields the class of the connected rank-incidence graph H1, while the known Feng–Nukala homotopy theorem concentrates rational homology in degree two. The two Jacobi–Trudi telescoping computations yield precisely the claimed Specht families; semisimplicity converts classes to representations. No sign or trivial representation occurs in the displayed partitions, so S_m and A_m invariants vanish. Fresh independent clique enumeration and hook-length dimensions agree at (m,k)=(5,2),(6,2),(6,3): respectively 260/19, 756/55, 756/55 nonempty faces/Euler H2 rank. This checks only these cases; the all-parameter conclusion depends on the exact chain argument and cited homological concentration.
